body:
Investigate the /cv page of this Astro site. I need to understand:

1. Where is the CV page component/layout? (likely src/pages/cv.astro or similar)
2. How is content structured — is there a data file (JSON/YAML/TS) feeding it, or is content hardcoded in the .astro file?
3. Is there an existing "certifications" or "education" section? If so, what format does each entry use (title, issuer, date, link, image)?
4. How are images referenced/stored for the CV page? (src/assets, public/, etc.)
5. Show me the exact file paths and relevant code snippets for the certifications/education section.

Deliverables: file paths, code snippets of the relevant section, and the data structure used for entries.
